ayahs.1: Alif Laam Ra, yeh raushan kitaab ki aayaten hain.
ayahs.2: Yaqeenan hum ne is ko Quran Arabi naazil farmaya hai ke tum samajh sako.
ayahs.3: Hum aap ke saamne behtareen bayan pesh karte hain is wajah se ke hum ne aap ki jaanib yeh Quran wahi ke zariye naazil kiya aur yaqeenan aap is se pehle be-khabron mein se the.
ayahs.4: Jab ke Yusuf ne apne baap se zikr kiya ke abba jaan main ne gyarah sitaron ko aur sooraj chaand ko dekha ke woh sab mujhe sajda kar rahe hain.
ayahs.5: Yaqoob (alaihis salaam) ne kaha pyare bachche! Apne is khwab ka zikr apne bhaiyon se na karna. Aisa na ho ke woh tere saath koi fareb-kaari karen, shaitan to insan ka khula dushman hai.
ayahs.6: Aur isi tarah tujhe tera parwardigar bar-guzida karega aur tujhe mamla-fehmi (ya khwabon ki tabeer) bhi sikhaayega aur apni nemat tujhe bharpoor ata farmaayega aur Yaqoob ke ghar walon ko bhi, jaise ke us ne is se pehle tere dada aur par-dada yani Ibraheem-o-Ishaaq ko bhi bharpoor apni nemat di, yaqeenan tera Rabb bahut bade ilm wala aur zabardast hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.7: Yaqeenan Yusuf aur us ke bhaiyon mein daryaaft karne walon ke liye (badi) nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.8: Jab ke unhon ne kaha ke Yusuf aur us ka bhai ba-nisbat hamare, baap ko bahut ziyada pyare hain, halaanke hum (taaqatwar) jamaat hain, koi shak nahin ke hamare abba sareeh ghalti mein hain.
ayahs.9: Yusuf ko to maar hi daalo ya use kisi (na-maloom) jagah phenk do ke tumhare walid ka rukh sirf tumhari taraf hi ho jaaye. Is ke baad tum nek ho jaana.
ayahs.10: In mein se ek ne kaha Yusuf ko qatl to na karo balke use kisi andhe kuen (ki tah) mein daal aao ke use koi (aata jaata) qaafila utha le jaaye, agar tumhein karna hi hai to yun karo.
ayahs.11: Unhon ne kaha abba! Aakhir aap Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke baare mein hum par eitbaar kyun nahin karte, hum to is ke khair-khwah hain.
ayahs.12: Kal aap use zaroor hamare saath bhej dijiye ke khoob khaaye piye aur khele, is ki hifaazat ke hum zimma-daar hain.
ayahs.13: (Yaqoob alaihis salaam ne) kaha use tumhara le jaana mujhe to sakht sadma dega aur mujhe yeh bhi khatka laga rahega ke tumhari ghaflat mein use bheriya kha jaaye.
ayahs.14: Unhon ne jawab diya ke hum jaisi (zor-aawar) jamaat ki maujoodgi mein bhi agar use bheriya kha jaaye to hum bilkul nikamme hi hue.
ayahs.15: Phir jab use le chale aur sab ne mil kar thaan liya ke use ghair-aabaad gehre kuen ki tah mein phenk den, hum ne Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ki taraf wahi ki ke yaqeenan (waqt aa raha hai ke) tu unhen is maajra ki khabar is haal mein dega ke woh jaante hi na hon.
ayahs.16: Aur isha ke waqt (woh sab) apne baap ke paas rote hue pahunche.
ayahs.17: Aur kehne lage ke abba jaan hum to aapas mein daud mein lag gaye aur Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ko hum ne asbaab ke paas chhoda pas use bheriya kha gaya, aap to hamari baat nahin maanenge, go hum bilkul sachche hi hon.
ayahs.18: Aur Yusuf ke kurte ko jhoot-moot ke khoon se khoon-aalood bhi kar laaye the, baap ne kaha yun nahin, balke tum ne apne dil hi se ek baat bana li hai. Pas sabr hi behtar hai, aur tumhari banaayi hui baaton par Allah hi se madad ki talab hai.
ayahs.19: Aur ek qaafila aaya aur unhon ne apne paani laane wale ko bheja, us ne apna dol latka diya, kehne laga wah wah khushi ki baat hai yeh to ek ladka hai, unhon ne use maal-e-tijaarat qaraar de kar chhupa diya aur Allah Taala is se ba-khabar tha jo woh kar rahe the.
ayahs.20: Aur unhon ne use bahut hi halki qeemat par ginti ke chand dirhamon par hi bech daala, woh to Yusuf ke baare mein bahut hi be-raghbat the.
ayahs.21: Misr walon mein se jis ne use khareeda tha us ne apni biwi se kaha ke use bahut izzat-o-ehtiraam ke saath rakho, bahut mumkin hai ke yeh hamein faaida pahunchaaye ya use hum apna beta hi bana len, yun hum ne Misr ki sarzameen mein Yusuf ka qadam jama diya ke hum use khwab ki tabeer ka kuchh ilm sikha den. Allah apne irade par ghaalib hai lekin aksar log be-ilm hote hain.
ayahs.22: Aur jab (Yusuf) pukhtagi ki umr ko pahunch gaye hum ne use quwwat-e-faisla aur ilm diya, hum nek-kaaron ko isi tarah badla dete hain.
ayahs.23: Us aurat ne jis ke ghar mein Yusuf the, Yusuf ko behlaana phuslaana shuru kiya ke woh apne nafs ki nigraani chhod de aur darwaze band kar ke kehne lagi lo aa jao. Yusuf ne kaha Allah ki panah! Woh mera Rabb hai, mujhe us ne bahut achchi tarah rakha hai. Be-insaafi karne walon ka bhala nahin hota.
ayahs.24: Us aurat ne Yusuf ki taraf qasd kiya aur Yusuf is ka qasd karte agar woh apne parwardigar ki daleel na dekhte, yunhi hua is waaste ke hum is se buraai aur be-hayaai door kar den. Beshak woh hamare chune hue bandon mein se tha.
ayahs.25: Donon darwaze ki taraf daude aur us aurat ne Yusuf ka kurta peechhe ki taraf se kheench kar phaad daala aur darwaze ke paas hi aurat ka shauhar donon ko mil gaya, to kehne lagi jo shakhs teri biwi ke saath bura irada kare bas is ki saza yehi hai ke use qaid kar diya jaaye ya aur koi dardnaak saza di jaaye.
ayahs.26: Yusuf ne kaha yeh aurat hi mujhe phuslaa rahi thi, aur aurat ke qabeele hi ke ek shakhs ne gawahi di ke agar is ka kurta aage se phata hua ho to aurat sachchi hai aur Yusuf jhoot bolne walon mein se hai.
ayahs.27: Aur agar is ka kurta peechhe ki jaanib se phaada gaya hai to aurat jhooti hai aur Yusuf sachchon mein se hai.
ayahs.28: Khawind ne jo dekha ke Yusuf ka kurta peeth ki jaanib se phaada gaya hai to saaf keh diya ke yeh to tum aurton ki chaal-baazi hai, beshak tumhari chaal-baazi bahut badi hai.
ayahs.29: Yusuf ab is baat ko aati jaati karo aur (aye aurat) tu apne gunaah se tauba kar, beshak tu gunahgaaron mein se hai.
ayahs.30: Aur shehar ki aurton mein charcha hone laga ke Aziz ki biwi apne (jawan) ghulam ko apna matlab nikaalne ke liye behlaane phuslaane mein lagi rehti hai, un ke dil mein Yusuf ki mohabbat baith gayi hai, hamare khayaal mein to woh sareeh gumraahi mein hai.
ayahs.31: Us ne jab un ki is par fareb ghibat ka haal suna to unhen bulwa bheja aur un ke liye ek majlis murattab ki aur un mein se har ek ko chhuri di. Aur kaha aye Yusuf! Un ke saamne chale aao, un aurton ne jab use dekha to bahut bada jaana aur apne haath kaat liye, aur zabaan se nikal gaya ke hashallah! Yeh insan to hargiz nahin, yeh to yaqeenan koi bahut hi buzurg farishta hai.
ayahs.32: Us waqt Aziz-e-Misr ki biwi ne kaha, yehi hai jin ke baare mein tum mujhe taane de rahi thin, main ne har chand is se apna matlab haasil karna chaha lekin yeh baal baal bacha raha, aur jo kuchh main is se keh rahi hoon agar yeh na karega to yaqeenan yeh qaid kar diya jaayega aur beshak yeh bahut hi be-izzat hoga.
ayahs.33: Yusuf ne dua ki ke aye mere parwardigar! Jis baat ki taraf yeh aurten mujhe bula rahi hain is se to mujhe jail-khana bahut pasand hai, agar tu ne un ka fann-e-fareb mujh se door na kiya to main to un ki taraf maail ho jaunga aur bilkul naadaanon mein ja miloonga.
ayahs.34: Is ke Rabb ne is ki dua qabool kar li aur un aurton ke daanw-pech is se pher diye, yaqeenan woh sunne wala jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.35: Phir in tamaam nishaaniyon ke dekh lene ke baad bhi unhen yehi maslahat maloom hui ke Yusuf ko kuchh muddat ke liye qaid-khana mein rakhen.
ayahs.36: Is ke saath hi do aur jawan bhi jail-khane mein daakhil hue, in mein se ek ne kaha ke main ne khwab mein apne aap ko sharaab nichodte dekha hai, aur doosre ne kaha main ne apne aap ko dekha hai ke main apne sar par roti uthaaye hue hoon jise parinde kha rahe hain, hamein aap is ki tabeer bataiye, hamein to aap khoobiyon wale shakhs dikhaai dete hain.
ayahs.37: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne kaha tumhein jo khaana diya jaata hai is ke tumhare paas pahunchne se pehle hi main tumhein is ki tabeer batla doonga. Yeh sab is ilm ki badaulat hai jo mujhe mere Rabb ne sikhaya hai, main ne un logon ka mazhab chhod diya hai jo Allah par imaan nahin rakhte aur aakhirat ke bhi munkir hain.
ayahs.38: Main apne baap dadon ke deen ka paaband hoon, yani Ibraheem-o-Ishaaq aur Yaqoob ke deen ka, hamein hargiz yeh sazaawaar nahin ke hum Allah Taala ke saath kisi ko bhi shareek karen, hum par aur tamaam aur logon par Allah Taala ka yeh khaas fazl hai, lekin aksar log na-shukri karte hain.
ayahs.39: Aye mere qaid-khane ke saathiyo! Kya mutafarriq kayi ek parwardigar behtar hain? Ya ek Allah zabardast taaqatwar?
ayahs.40: Is ke siwa tum jin ki pooja paat kar rahe ho woh sab naam hi naam hain jo tum ne aur tumhare baap dadon ne khud hi ghad liye hain. Allah Taala ne un ki koi daleel naazil nahin farmaayi, farmaanrawaai sirf Allah Taala hi ki hai, is ka farmaan hai ke tum sab siwaye is ke kisi aur ki ibaadat na karo, yehi deen durust hai lekin aksar log nahin jaante.
ayahs.41: Aye mere qaid-khane ke rafeeqo! Tum donon mein se ek to apne baadshah ko sharaab pilaane par muqarrar ho jaayega, lekin doosra sooli par chadhaaya jaayega aur parinde is ka sar noch noch khaayenge, tum donon jis ke baare mein tehqeeq kar rahe the is kaam ka faisla kar diya gaya.
ayahs.42: Aur jis ki nisbat Yusuf ka gumaan tha ke in donon mein se yeh chhoot jaayega us se kaha ke apne baadshah se mera zikr bhi kar dena, phir use shaitan ne apne baadshah se zikr karna bhula diya aur Yusuf ne kayi saal qaid-khane mein hi kaate.
ayahs.43: Baadshah ne kaha, main ne khwab mein dekha hai ke saat moti taazi farba gaayen hain jin ko saat laaghar dubli patli gaayen kha rahi hain aur saat baaliyan hain hari hari aur doosri saat bilkul khushk. Aye darbaario! Mere is khwab ki tabeer batlao agar tum khwab ki tabeer de sakte ho.
ayahs.44: Unhon ne jawab diya ke yeh to udte udaate pareshaan khwab hain aur aise shoreeda pareshaan khwabon ki tabeer jaanne wale hum nahin.
ayahs.45: In do qaidiyon mein se jo riha hua tha use muddat ke baad yaad aa gaya aur kehne laga main tumhein is ki tabeer batla doonga, mujhe jaane ki ijaazat dijiye.
ayahs.46: Aye Yusuf! Aye bahut bade sachche Yusuf! Aap hamein is khwab ki tabeer batlaiye ke saat moti taazi gaayen hain jinhen saat dubli patli gaayen kha rahi hain aur saat bilkul sabz khushe hain aur saat hi doosre bilkul khushk hain, taake main wapas ja kar un logon se kahoon ke woh sab jaan len.
ayahs.47: Yusuf ne jawab diya ke tum saat saal tak pai-dar-pai lagataar hasb-e-aadat ghalla boya karna, aur fasal kaat kar use baaliyon samet hi rehne dena siwaye apne khaane ki thodi si miqdaar ke.
ayahs.48: Is ke baad saat saal nihaayat sakht qaht aayenge, woh is ghalle ko kha jaayenge, jo tum ne un ke liye zakheera rakh chhoda tha, siwaye is thode se ke jo tum rok rakhte ho.
ayahs.49: Is ke baad jo saal aayega is mein logon par khoob baarish barsaayi jaayegi aur is mein (sheera-e-angoor bhi) khoob nichodenge.
ayahs.50: Aur baadshah ne kaha Yusuf ko mere paas lao, jab qaasid Yusuf ke paas pahuncha to unhon ne kaha, apne baadshah ke paas wapas ja aur us se poochh ke un aurton ka haqeeqi waqia kya hai jinhon ne apne haath kaat liye the? Un ke heele ko (saheeh taur par) jaanne wala mera parwardigar hi hai.
ayahs.51: Baadshah ne poochha aye aurto! Is waqt ka saheeh waqia kya hai jab tum daanw-fareb kar ke Yusuf ko is ki dili mansha se behkaana chahti thin, unhon ne saaf jawab diya ke maaz Allah hum ne Yusuf mein koi buraai nahin paayi, phir to Aziz ki biwi bhi bol uthi ke ab to sachchi baat nithar aayi. Main ne hi use warghalaaya tha, is ke ji se, aur yaqeenan woh sachchon mein se hai.
ayahs.52: (Yusuf alaihis salaam ne kaha) Yeh is waaste ke (Aziz) jaan le ke main ne is ki peeth peechhe is ki khiyaanat nahin ki aur yeh bhi ke Allah dagha-baazon ke hathkande chalne nahin deta.
ayahs.53: Main apne nafs ki paakeezgi bayan nahin karta. Beshak nafs to buraai par ubharne wala hi hai, magar yeh ke mera parwardigar hi apna rahm kare, yaqeenan mera paalne wala badi bakhshish karne wala aur bahut mehrbani farmaane wala hai.
ayahs.54: Baadshah ne kaha use mere paas lao ke main use apne khaas kaamon ke liye muqarrar kar loon, phir jab is se baat cheet ki to kehne laga ke aap hamare haan aaj se zi-izzat aur amaanat-daar hain.
ayahs.55: (Yusuf ne) kaha aap mujhe mulk ke khazanon par muqarrar kar dijiye, main hifaazat karne wala aur ba-khabar hoon.
ayahs.56: Isi tarah hum ne Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ko mulk ka qabza de diya. Ke woh jahan kahin chahe rahe sahe, hum jise chahen apni rahmat pahuncha dete hain. Hum neko-kaaron ka sawaab zaaya nahin karte.
ayahs.57: Yaqeenan imaan-daaron aur parhezgaaron ka ukhrawi ajr bahut hi behtar hai.
ayahs.58: Yusuf ke bhai aaye aur Yusuf ke paas gaye to us ne unhen pehchaan liya aur unhon ne use na pehchaana.
ayahs.59: Jab unhen un ka asbaab muhayya kar diya to kaha ke tum mere paas apne is bhai ko bhi laana jo tumhare baap se hai, kya tum ne nahin dekha ke main poora naap kar deta hoon aur main hoon bhi behtareen mezbaani karne walon mein.
ayahs.60: Pas agar tum use le kar paas na aaye to meri taraf se tumhein koi naap bhi na milega balke tum mere qareeb bhi na phatakna.
ayahs.61: Unhon ne kaha achcha hum is ke baap ko is ki baabat phuslaayenge aur poori koshish karenge.
ayahs.62: Apne khidmat-gaaron se kaha ke un ki poonji unhi ki boriyon mein rakh do ke jab laut kar apne ahl-o-ayaal mein jaayen aur poonjiyon ko pehchaan len to bahut mumkin hai ke yeh phir laut kar aayen.
ayahs.63: Jab yeh log laut kar apne walid ke paas gaye to kehne lage ke hum se to ghalle ka naap rok liya gaya. Ab aap hamare saath hamare bhai ko bhejiye ke hum paimaana bhar kar laayen, hum is ki nigehbaani ke zimma-daar hain.
ayahs.64: (Yaqoob alaihis salaam ne) kaha ke mujhe to is ki baabat tumhara bas waisa hi eitbaar hai jaisa is se pehle is ke bhai ke baare mein tha, bas Allah hi behtareen haafiz hai aur woh sab mehrbaanon se bada mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.65: Jab unhon ne apna asbaab khola to apna sarmaaya maujood paaya jo un ki jaanib lautaaya gaya tha. Kehne lage aye hamare baap hamein aur kya chahiye. Dekhiye to yeh hamara sarmaaya bhi hamein wapas lautaaya gaya hai. Hum apne khaandaan ko rasad laden ge aur apne bhai ki nigraani rakhenge aur ek oont ke bojh ka ghalla ziyada laayenge. Yeh naap to bahut aasaan hai.
ayahs.66: Yaqoob (alaihis salaam) ne kaha! Main to use hargiz hargiz tumhare saath na bhejoon ga jab tak ke tum Allah ko beech mein rakh kar mujhe qaul-o-qaraar na do ke tum use mere paas pahuncha doge, siwaye is ek soorat ke ke tum sab giraftaar kar liye jao. Jab unhon ne pakka qaul-qaraar de diya to unhon ne kaha ke hum jo kuchh kehte hain Allah is par nigehbaan hai.
ayahs.67: Aur (Yaqoob alaihis salaam) ne kaha aye mere bachcho! Tum sab ek darwaze se na jaana balke kayi juda juda darwazon mein se daakhil hona. Main Allah ki taraf se aane wali kisi cheez ko tum se taal nahin sakta. Hukm sirf Allah hi ka chalta hai. Mera kaamil bharosa isi par hai aur har ek bharosa karne wale ko isi par bharosa karna chahiye.
ayahs.68: Jab woh unhi raaston se jin ka hukm un ke walid ne unhen diya tha, gaye. Kuchh na tha ke Allah ne jo baat muqarrar kar di hai woh is se unhen zara bhi bacha le. Magar Yaqoob (alaihis salaam) ke dil mein ek khayaal (paida hua) jise us ne poora kar liya, bila-shubha woh hamare sikhlaaye hue ilm ka aalim tha lekin aksar log nahin jaante.
ayahs.69: Yeh sab jab Yusuf ke paas pahunch gaye to us ne apne bhai ko apne paas bitha liya aur kaha main tera bhai (Yusuf) hoon, pas yeh jo kuchh karte rahe is ka kuchh ranj na kar.
ayahs.70: Phir jab unhen un ka saamaan asbaab theek thaak kar ke diya to apne bhai ke asbaab mein paani peene ka pyaala rakh diya. Phir ek aawaaz dene wale ne pukar kar kaha ke aye qaafile walo! Tum log to chor ho.
ayahs.71: Unhon ne un ki taraf munh pher kar kaha ke tumhari kya cheez khoyi gayi hai?
ayahs.72: Jawab diya ke shaahi paimaana gum hai jo use le aaye use ek oont ke bojh ka ghalla milega. Is wade ka main zaamin hoon.
ayahs.73: Unhon ne kaha Allah ki qasam! Tum ko khoob ilm hai ke hum mulk mein fasaad phailaane ke liye nahin aaye aur na hum chor hain.
ayahs.74: Unhon ne kaha achcha chor ki kya saza hai agar tum jhoote ho?
ayahs.75: Jawab diya ke is ki saza yehi hai ke jis ke asbaab mein se paaya jaaye wahi is ka badla hai. Hum to aise zaalimon ko yehi saza diya karte hain.
ayahs.76: Pas Yusuf ne un ke saamaan ki talaashi shuru ki, apne bhai ke saamaan ki talaashi se pehle, phir is paimaane ko apne bhai ke saamaan (zambeel) se nikaala. Hum ne Yusuf ke liye isi tarah yeh tadbeer ki. Us baadshah ke qaanoon ki ru se yeh apne bhai ko na le sakta tha magar yeh ke Allah ko manzoor ho. Hum jis ke chahen darje buland kar den, har zi-ilm par fauqiyat rakhne wala doosra zi-ilm maujood hai.
ayahs.77: Unhon ne kaha ke agar is ne chori ki (to koi taajjub ki baat nahin) is ka bhai bhi pehle chori kar chuka hai. Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne is baat ko apne dil mein rakh liya aur un ke saamne bilkul zaahir na kiya. Kaha ke tum badtar jagah mein ho, aur jo tum bayan karte ho use Allah hi khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.78: Unhon ne kaha ke aye Aziz-e-Misr! Is ke walid bahut badi umr ke bilkul boodhe shakhs hain. Aap is ke badle hum mein se kisi ko le lijiye. Hum dekhte hain ke aap bade nek-nafs hain.
ayahs.79: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne kaha hum ne jis ke paas apni cheez paayi hai is ke siwa doosre ki giraftaari karne se Allah ki panah chahte hain, aisa karne se to hum yaqeenan na-insaafi karne wale ho jaayenge.
ayahs.80: Jab yeh is se maayoos ho gaye to tanhaai mein baith kar mashwara karne lage. In mein jo sab se bada tha us ne kaha tumhein maloom nahin ke tumhare walid ne tum se Allah ki qasam le kar pukhta qaul-qaraar liya hai aur is se pehle Yusuf ke baare mein tum kotaahi kar chuke ho. Pas main to is sarzameen se na taloonga jab tak ke walid saahib khud mujhe ijaazat na den ya Allah Taala mere maamle ka faisla kar de, wahi behtareen faisla karne wala hai.
ayahs.81: Tum sab walid saahib ki khidmat mein wapas jao aur kaho ke abbaji! Aap ke saahibzaade ne chori ki aur hum ne wahi gawahi di thi jo hum jaante the. Hum kuchh ghaib ki hifaazat karne wale na the.
ayahs.82: Aap is shehar ke logon se daryaaft farma len jahan hum the aur is qaafile se bhi poochh len jis ke saath hum aaye hain, aur yaqeenan hum bilkul sachche hain.
ayahs.83: (Yaqoob alaihis salaam ne) kaha yeh to nahin, balke tum ne apni taraf se baat bana li, pas ab sabr hi behtar hai. Qareeb hai ke Allah Taala in sab ko mere paas hi pahuncha de. Wahi ilm-o-hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.84: Phir un se munh pher liya aur kaha haaye Yusuf! Un ki aankhen ba-wajah ranj-o-gham ke safed ho chuki thin aur woh gham ko dabaaye hue the.
ayahs.85: Beton ne kaha wallah! Aap hamesha Yusuf ki yaad hi mein lage rahenge yahan tak ke ghul jaayen ya khatm hi ho jaayen.
ayahs.86: Unhon ne kaha ke main to apni pareshaaniyon aur ranj ki faryaad Allah hi se kar raha hoon, mujhe Allah ki taraf se woh baaten maloom hain jo tum nahin jaante.
ayahs.87: Mere pyare bachcho! Tum jao aur Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ki aur is ke bhai ki poori tarah talaash karo aur Allah ki rahmat se na-umeed na ho. Yaqeenan Rabb ki rahmat se na-umeed wahi hote hain jo kaafir hote hain.
ayahs.88: Phir jab yeh log Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke paas pahunche to kehne lage ke aye Aziz! Hum ko aur hamare khaandaan ko dukh pahuncha hai. Hum haqeer poonji laaye hain pas aap hamein poore ghalle ka naap dijiye aur hum par khairaat kijiye, Allah Taala khairaat karne walon ko badla deta hai.
ayahs.89: Yusuf ne kaha jaante bhi ho ke tum ne Yusuf aur is ke bhai ke saath apni naadaani ki haalat mein kya kiya?
ayahs.90: Unhon ne kaha kya (waaqai) tu hi Yusuf (alaihis salaam) hai. Jawab diya ke haan main Yusuf (alaihis salaam) hoon aur yeh mera bhai hai. Allah ne hum par fazl-o-karam kiya, baat yeh hai ke jo bhi parhezgaari aur sabr kare to Allah Taala kisi neko-kaar ka ajr zaaya nahin karta.
ayahs.91: Unhon ne kaha Allah ki qasam! Allah Taala ne tujhe hum par bartari di hai aur yeh bhi bilkul sach hai ke hum khata-kaar the.
ayahs.92: Jawab diya aaj tum par koi malaamat nahin hai. Allah tumhein bakhshe, woh sab mehrbaanon se bada mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.93: Mera yeh kurta tum le jao aur use mere walid ke munh par daal do ke woh dekhne lagen, aur aa jaayen aur apne tamaam khaandaan ko mere paas le aao.
ayahs.94: Jab yeh qaafila juda hua to un ke walid ne kaha ke mujhe to Yusuf ki khushbu aa rahi hai agar tum mujhe sathiyaya hua qaraar na do.
ayahs.95: Woh kehne lage ke wallah aap apne isi puraane khabt mein mubtala hain.
ayahs.96: Jab khushkhabri dene wale ne pahunch kar un ke munh par woh kurta daala usi waqt woh phir se beena ho gaye. Kaha! Kya main tum se na kaha karta tha ke main Allah ki taraf se woh baaten jaanta hoon jo tum nahin jaante.
ayahs.97: Unhon ne kaha abbaji! Aap hamare liye gunahon ki bakhshish talab kijiye, beshak hum qasoor-waar hain.
ayahs.98: Kaha achcha main jald hi tumhare liye apne parwardigar se bakhshish maangoonga, woh bahut bada bakhshne wala aur nihaayat mehrbani karne wala hai.
ayahs.99: Jab yeh saara gharaana Yusuf ke paas pahunch gaya to Yusuf ne apne maan baap ko apne paas jagah di aur kaha ke Allah ko manzoor hai to aap sab amn-o-amaan ke saath Misr mein aao.
ayahs.100: Aur apne takht par apne maan baap ko ooncha bithaaya aur sab is ke saamne sajde mein gir gaye. Tab kaha ke abbaji! Yeh mere pehle ke khwab ki tabeer hai, mere Rabb ne use sachcha kar dikhaaya, is ne mere saath bada ehsaan kiya jab ke mujhe jail-khane se nikaala aur aap logon ko sehra se le aaya is ikhtilaaf ke baad jo shaitan ne mujh mein aur mere bhaiyon mein daal diya tha. Mera Rabb jo chahe is ke liye behtareen tadbeer karne wala hai. Aur woh bahut ilm-o-hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.101: Aye mere parwardigar! Tu ne mujhe mulk ata farmaaya aur tu ne mujhe khwab ki tabeer sikhlaayi. Aye aasman-o-zameen ke paida karne wale! Tu hi dunya-o-aakhirat mein mera wali (dost) aur kaarsaaz hai, tu mujhe Islam ki haalat mein faut kar aur nekon mein mila de.
ayahs.102: Yeh ghaib ki khabron mein se hai jis ki hum aap ki taraf wahi kar rahe hain. Aap un ke paas na the jab ke unhon ne apni baat thaan li thi aur woh fareb karne lage the.
ayahs.103: Go aap laakh chahen lekin aksar log imaan-daar na honge.
ayahs.104: Aap un se is par koi ujrat talab nahin kar rahe hain. Yeh to tamaam dunya ke liye nari naseehat hi naseehat hai.
ayahs.105: Aasmanon aur zameen mein bahut si nishaaniyan hain. Jin se yeh munh mode guzar jaate hain.
ayahs.106: In mein se aksar log ba-wajood Allah par imaan rakhne ke bhi mushrik hi hain.
ayahs.107: Kya woh is baat se be-khauf ho gaye hain ke un ke paas Allah ke azaabon mein se koi aam azaab aa jaaye ya un par achaanak qayamat toot pade aur woh be-khabar hi hon.
ayahs.108: Aap keh dijiye meri raah yehi hai. Main aur mere mutabaeen Allah ki taraf bula rahe hain, poore yaqeen aur eitmaad ke saath. Aur Allah paak hai aur main mushrikon mein nahin.
ayahs.109: Aap se pehle hum ne basti walon mein jitne Rasool bheje hain sab mard hi the jin ki taraf hum wahi naazil farmaate gaye. Kya zameen mein chal phir kar unhon ne dekha nahin ke un se pehle ke logon ka kaisa kuchh anjaam hua? Yaqeenan aakhirat ka ghar parhezgaron ke liye bahut hi behtar hai, kya phir bhi tum nahin samajhte.
ayahs.110: Yahan tak ke jab Rasool na-umeed hone lage aur woh (qaum ke log) khayaal karne lage ke unhen jhoot kaha gaya. Foran hi hamari madad un ke paas aa pahunchi, jise hum ne chaha use najaat di gayi. Baat yeh hai ke hamara azaab gunahgaaron se wapas nahin kiya jaata.
ayahs.111: In ke bayan mein aqal walon ke liye yaqeenan naseehat aur ibrat hai, yeh Quran jhoot banaayi hui baat nahin balke yeh tasdeeq hai un kitabon ki jo is se pehle ki hain, khol khol kar bayan karne wala hai har cheez ko aur hidayat aur rahmat hai imaan-daar logon ke liye.
